crossRefs.note: This land we took in possession at that time: from Aroer, which is by the valley of the Arnon, and half the hill…
and the rest of Gilead, and all Bashan, the kingdom of Og, I gave to the half-tribe of Manasseh—all the region of…
Moses gave to them, even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh the…

parallels.note: Joshua spoke to the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh, saying,

people.name: Manasseh
people.line: Firstborn son of Joseph, blessed by Jacob.

people.name: Reuben
people.line: Firstborn son of Jacob and Leah

translations.web: We took their land, and gave it for an inheritance to the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to the half-tribe of the Manassites.
translations.bsb: We took their land and gave it as an inheritance to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.
translations.kjv: And we took their land, and gave it for an inheritance unto the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to the half tribe of Manasseh.
translations.asv: and we took their land, and gave it for an inheritance unto the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to the half-tribe of the Manassites.
